steps.npc: Hey there! Do you have a grapple I can borrow?

steps.player: I might have one, but I need it myself. Why do you need a grapple?

steps.npc: I need it to grapple to that pillar over there and get some treasure of course. What else could I need it for?

steps.player: I mean that makes sense I suppose. How did you end up here?

steps.npc: Well, I made my way to Morytania in search of a place called the Ba... Barlows? I've heard it's a great way to earn gold.
Anyways, I got lost on the way here and was abducted by some vampyres! However, I'm so sneaky I managed to escape and find this place.
The weird hooded guy at the top said that if I get him some hollow marks, he'll help me escape.
Yeah, that's what I said. Don't you listen?
So, can I borrow a grapple?

steps.text: If the player does not have a grapple:

steps.player: No, I don't have a grapple on me.

steps.npc: Well, you're clearly a noob then.

steps.text: If the player has a mithril grapple:

steps.player: Yes, I do have a spare grapple. I'm not sure you'd be able to use it to get across that gap though, what is your Ranged level?

steps.npc: Pfft, I'm level 50 Ranged. Over half-way to 99, getting over there will be a breeze.

steps.player: You need 62 Ranged to make it across that gap.

steps.npc: Maybe you do with that attitude.

steps.text: If the player has a hallowed grapple:

steps.player: Yes, I do have a spare grapple, although I spent a lot of Hallowed marks to obtain it so you can't have it.

steps.npc: Keep your grapple then noob. I can make that jump without it anyway.

steps.player: Oh yeah? What's your agility level?
